intro.text:
The classic first CFD test: a box of fluid whose lid slides to the right at 1 m/s.

Watch one big vortex spin up (Re = 100).

outro.text:
One moving wall is enough to set the whole box turning.

OpenFOAM icoFoam · 2D laminar, Re = 100

captions.text: The lid slides right at 1 m/s and drags the fluid just beneath it along.
White lines are streamlines, the paths the fluid follows. Colour shows speed.
Blocked by the right wall, the fluid turns down, and the whole box starts turning clockwise.
The dark spot is the eye of the vortex, where the fluid barely moves.
After half a second the pattern has stopped changing: the flow is steady.
